subject: Musical Frogs
text: Playing the Song of Storms to the Musical Frogs upstream in Zora's River rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Go upstream to the Musical Frogs, and play them the Song of Storms, plus any other songs which you haven't played for them yet.  When you play the Song of Storms, then they will give you a Piece of Heart.

subject: Musical Frogs
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Sun's Song, Saria's Song, Song of Storms, and Song of Time to the Musical Frogs unlocks another minigame.

evidence.quote: Play the rest of the basic songs (Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Sun's Song, Saria's Song, Song of Storms and Song of Time), and the Musical Frogs will challenge you with another minigame.  Stand on the log and whip out the Ocarina to play the game.

subject: Musical Frogs minigame
text: In the Musical Frogs minigame, the lowest frog corresponds to the A Button while the remaining four correspond to the directions on the C-Pad.

evidence.quote: Flies will appear above the Frog's heads, and you must press the button associated with that frog to make him eat it.  The lowest frog is matched with the A Button, and the remaining four frogs in the cross-shape are matched to each direction on the C-Pad.

subject: Musical Frogs minigame
text: Completing the button sequence A Button, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down, A Button, C-Down, A Button, C-Down, C-Right, C-Left, A Button in the Musical Frogs minigame awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
You can also play a minigame with the Frogs to win ANOTHER Piece of Heart....The order is as follows:
A Button, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down, A Button, C-Down, A
Button, C-Down, C-Right, C-Left, A Button

subject: Bolero of Fire
text: Playing the Bolero of Fire warps Link to Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: Once you have both Pieces of Heart from the Musical Frogs, play the Bolero of Fire to warp to Death Mountain Crater.

subject: Death Mountain Crater
text: Without the Goron Tunic, time spent in Death Mountain Crater is limited before dying from the heat.

evidence.quote: Without the protection of the Goron Tunic, your time here is limited before you die from the heat, so let's be quick.

subject: soft earth
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the soft earth patch to the left of the warp-in point produces a Gold Skulltula whose token can be collected.

evidence.quote: Begin by looking to the left from where you warp in, where you will find one of those elusive patches of soft earth.  Drop a Bottled Bug into it (you haven't thrown it away, have you!?), but remember to recapture one of the three who comes out.  Kill the Gold Skulltula and take it's token, then plant one of your two remaining Magic Beans in the patch.

subject: Prelude of Light
text: Playing the Prelude of Light returns Link to the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: Play the Prelude of Light to return to the Temple of Time.

subject: Master Sword
text: Drawing the Master Sword returns Link to adulthood.

evidence.quote: Take the Master Sword once more to return to Adulthood, and play the Bolero of Fire to head back to Death Mountain Crater.

subject: pile of rubble
text: Riding the sprouted Magic Leaf and jumping onto the tall pile of rubble awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Board the Magic Leaf and ride it up.  Near the start of it's path, it will pass by a tall pile of rubble with a Piece of Heart on top and loop around it several times.  Jump off the leaf onto the pile of rubble to get the Heart Piece.

subject: cliff alcove
text: Riding the Magic Leaf near the south entrance allows jumping to a rock by the cliff face and climbing down to an alcove containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: The Leaf will pass briefly by a large rock right near the cliff face; this is your opportunity to jump out to the cliff....Walk slowly off the cliff to grab hold of the rock face, and climb down a short distance to an alcove halfway down the cliff face.  Climb below the alcove, then climb up into it (if you try to drop down from above, you'll just fall right into the lava).  Take the Piece of Heart, then play the Bolero of Fire to warp back down to the pedestal (it's faster then climbing back up).

subject: stone structure
text: Crossing the bridge north of the pedestal and climbing down the ladder into the pit inside the stone structure leads to the Fire Temple entrance.

evidence.quote: From the pedestal, head north across the bridge and into the large stone structure.  Climb down the ladder into the pit, and enter the doorway adjacent to the ladder to enter the Fire Temple.

subject: Fire Temple
text: Reaching the Fire Temple boss chamber next to the entrance requires activating a bridge accessible from the dungeon's top floor.

evidence.quote: The boss' chamber is literally next door to the entrance.  The challenge in reaching it is in activating the bridge which leads to his door, which can only be accessed at the dungeon's top-most floor.

subject: trapped Gorons
text: Rescuing trapped Gorons throughout the Fire Temple provides Small Keys and the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: The dungeon is also unique in that Keys aren't really hidden, but are instead sort-of rewards for rescuing the Gorons trapped in the dungeon.  Even the Boss Key is held by one of the Gorons.  Rescuing all of them is a necessary, if tedious, part of the dungeon.

subject: Fire Keese
text: Fire Keese flap around above the stairs in the Entrance Hall.

evidence.quote: Run up the stairs as you enter, watching out for the Fire Keese who flap around above.  Kill them with arrows if you like, then head through the door on the left at the top of the stairs.

subject: Darunia
text: Darunia appears in the Pillar Room and heads off to fight Volvagia after asking Link to rescue the imprisoned Gorons.

evidence.quote: In this room you'll meet with Darunia.  He'll run off to fight Volvagia, and begs Link to rescue the Gorons who are being held prisoner in the Fire Temple.

subject: Pillar Room cell chest
text: Stepping on the switch across the lava pillars in the Pillar Room opens a cell containing a Goron and a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Look to the left after the cutscene, and you'll see a number of pillars rising out of the lava.  Jump out to these pillars, and along them to the platform in the left corner of the room.  Step onto the switch to open the cell directly in front of you.  Speak with the Goron inside to free him, then open the chest in his cell to find a Small Key.

subject: Entrance Hall
text: Running straight across the Entrance Hall leads to the Lava Cavern.

evidence.quote: Run straight across the room and enter the door on the other side....Run to the left side of this large room.  You can work your way along the series of platforms in the middle of the room, or you can go along the border of the room, or you can just march right through the lava.

subject: Prison Corridor #1 cell chest
text: Stepping on the switch in Prison Corridor #1 opens a cell containing a Goron and a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Run down to the end of the hall and step on the switch to open the cell door.  Speak with the Goron and open the chest inside to get another Small Key.

subject: Block of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time moves the Block of Time in the Lava Cavern to allow access to the upper door leading to the Killer Tile Room.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time to make the block change positions, blocking the door you just came through.  Climb up onto the Block of Time, and go through the door on top of the sandstone platform.

subject: Like-Like
text: A Like-Like in the Killer Tile Room can swallow Link and eat his clothes and Hylian Shield, which can be reclaimed once it is killed.

evidence.quote: Near the back of the room is a strange, pulsating creature.  This is a Like-Like, a relatively weak enemy who does possess the rather annoying ability to eat your Clothes and Hylian Shield.  Slash him to death (use the Biggoron Sword if you have it), and if he manages to swallow you, reclaim your stolen items after he dies.

subject: Killer Tile Room wall
text: Killing the Gold Skulltula on the wall of the Killer Tile Room yields a Gold Skulltula token.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall and take it's token, then return to the previous room.
